_note: P15 D8 — the cost envelope, with every number carrying where it came from. This file is the single source of truth for the arithmetic in docs/P15-deployment.md (D2), docs/P15-cost.md and infra/terraform/outputs.tf; tools/p15-cost.py --check fails if the three disagree, because three copies of a number is how a budget becomes a rumour.

sources.hetzner: hetzner.com published pricing, cross-checked against three resellers during P15 D2; the EU CPX22 rises on 2026-04-01 and the post-rise price is the one budgeted
sources.neon: Neon Launch $0.106/CU-hour and $0.35/GB-month, published; 1 CU = 1 vCPU / 4 GB; no monthly minimum since Dec 2025
sources.upstash: Upstash PAYG $0.20 per 100k commands after the free tier; the range is the launch traffic estimate, not provider variance
sources.cloudflare: R2 $0.015/GB-month with free egress; the free tier covers 10 GB, so the backup bucket is nearly free at launch
sources.managed_extras: Sentry and Grafana Cloud free tiers at launch; the 10x column budgets the team plan

scaling_plan.1k_users: 1 × CPX32 + Neon 1 CU + Upstash: ~$119/month (the launch column)
scaling_plan.10k_users: 2 × CPX32 + the same Neon shape, cache self-hosted on the second box: ~$150/month
scaling_plan.100k_users: the 10x column, ~$270/month, with Neon capped at 2 CU + a replica and the analytics tape trimmed to 30 days
